informal_statement:
For real \(m,c\),
\[
R>0,
\]
and \(0\leq\theta\leq\pi\), the Lebesgue volume of
\[
\{(x,y):(x-m)^2+(y-c)^2\leq R^2,\ y\geq c+R\cos\theta\}
\]
is
\[
R^2(\theta-\sin\theta\cos\theta),
\]
embedded in the nonnegative extended reals.
reason: Source `CMVGeometry.lean:1820-1944`: The disk/half-plane volume formula is valid on the entire closed cap-angle interval; it is not limited to minor segments.
